label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — User-controlled input 'param' from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to host variable, which is used to construct URL at line 41 ('http://' + host + '/v1'). Although isNonPublicAddress check exists at line 40, it only blocks loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local addresses AFTER DNS resolution, allowing external IPs or domains to pass through. The resolved sink value at line 41 is 'http://{user_input}/v1' which is attacker-controlled. This enables SSRF to external hosts.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request.getParameter assigned to param/host
DNS resolution check followed by URL construction with user-controlled host reaching sink at line 41
